recommendation: Keep this commit as-is. It is a narrow correction to the FHIR-23709 implementation that keeps ActivityDefinition.kind searchable exactly once and does not require further work-group review.
issue_request: FHIR-23709 was a Published/Persuasive CDS change request asking to add kind as a search parameter for ActivityDefinition, because knowledge vendors use ActivityDefinition.kind to classify protocols, order sets, recommendations, and similar definitions.
initial_application: The issue had already been applied in source history. Commit 774eccb4c1 added ActivityDefinition-kind in the ActivityDefinition search-parameter bundle, and commit 1f7ca3b620, later included through PR #2288, added the same ActivityDefinition-kind parameter again near the end of the same bundle. Before reconciliation, the current source therefore had the requested search parameter twice with the same id, URL, code, type, and expression.
additional_context: ActivityDefinition is an active resource in source/fhir.ini and assigned to the CDS work group, so its search-parameter bundle is in current build scope. Neighboring kind search parameters for resources such as OperationDefinition, NamingSystem, and StructureDefinition are single definitions. Jira search found only FHIR-23709 for this exact request, and Zulip/Confluence searches found no relevant discussion changing the source conclusion.
reconciliation: Removed only the redundant appended ActivityDefinition-kind SearchParameter entry from source/activitydefinition/bundle-ActivityDefinition-search-params.xml, leaving the sorted existing ActivityDefinition.kind token search parameter in place.
source_changes: source/activitydefinition/bundle-ActivityDefinition-search-params.xml: removed the second duplicate ActivityDefinition-kind SearchParameter entry, leaving the existing code kind/type token/expression ActivityDefinition.kind definition.
